Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From bd53280ef042301ea9663824568ecba5a88b2f9d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Janusz Krzysztofik <janusz.krzysztofik@linux.intel.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2019 15:32:31 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/drv: Fix incorrect resolution of merge conflict

Commit f06ddb53096b ("BackMerge v5.1-rc5 into drm-next") incorrectly
resolved a merge conflict related to a patch having been merged twice:
- commit 3f04e0a6cfeb ("drm: Fix drm_release() and device unplug")
  introduced as a standalone fix via drm-fixes branch,
- commit 1ee57d4d75fb ("drm: Fix drm_release() and device unplug")
  applied as patch 1/2 of a series on drm-next branch.
That incorrect resolution of the conflict effectively reverted a change
introduced to drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c by patch 2/2 of that series -
commit ba3bf37e150a ("drm/drv: drm_dev_unplug(): Move out drm_dev_put()
call").  Fix it.

Fixes: f06ddb53096b ("BackMerge v5.1-rc5 into drm-next")
Signed-off-by: Janusz Krzysztofik <janusz.krzysztofik@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Dave Airlie <airlied@redhat.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20190417133232.16232-1-janusz.krzysztofik@linux.intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
index e87799e3e7ff..50d849d1bc6e 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c
@@ -508,7 +508,6 @@ void drm_dev_unplug(struct drm_device *dev)
 	synchronize_srcu(&drm_unplug_srcu);
 
 	drm_dev_unregister(dev);
-	drm_dev_put(dev);
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL(drm_dev_unplug);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c`**
   - **Line Removed**: The line `drm_dev_put(dev);` was removed from the `drm_dev_unplug` function. This change restores the behavior prior to the incorrect merge conflict resolution, ensuring that the `drm_dev_put` call is not executed when the device is unplugged.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `drivers/gpu/drm/drm_drv.c` addresses a bug introduced by a previous commit (f06ddb53096b) that incorrectly resolved a merge conflict. The removal of the `drm_dev_put(dev);` line corrects the behavior of the `drm_dev_unplug` function, which had been altered due to the merge conflict resolution. This fix ensures that the functionality aligns with the intended behavior established by earlier commits (specifically, commit ba3bf37e150a) that aimed to improve device unplug handling.

        The bug was caused by an incorrect resolution of a merge conflict during the back merge of two branches, which led to the unintended removal of the `drm_dev_put(dev);` call in the `drm_dev_unplug` function. This change reverted a critical fix that was intended to manage device reference counting properly when a device is unplugged, potentially leading to resource leaks or improper device state management.

        drm/drv: Fix incorrect resolution of merge conflict

 void drm_dev_unplug(struct drm_device *dev)
 {
 	/*
 	 * After synchronizing any critical read section is guaranteed to see
 	 * the new value of ->unplugged, and any critical section which might
 	 * still have seen the old value of ->unplugged is guaranteed to have
 	 * finished.
 	 */
 	dev->unplugged = true;
 	synchronize_srcu(&drm_unplug_srcu);
 
 	drm_dev_unregister(dev);
-	drm_dev_put(dev);
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL(drm_dev_unplug);
